description: Evaluation-contract exercise manifest. Classifies contract modules by reachability from a real runner entrypoint, not by imports alone.
limitation: No production provider has been exercised. Reachable-by-safe_runner means synthetic evidence only; it does not establish real model outcomes.

status_classes.real_run: Reached by a runner that executes a real provider/model and records served-model identity.
status_classes.synthetic_run: Reached by a real runner using deterministic synthetic adapters or rule-based classification.
status_classes.internally_wired: Imported by other contract modules but not reachable from any registered runner entrypoint.
status_classes.test_only: Exercised only by test files; no non-test importer.
status_classes.orphaned: No importer and no registered exercise evidence.

synthetic_run: protocol validation with the echo adapter
schema and coverage-gate behavior under deterministic classification

known_limitations.description: docs/dogmas/eval/scripts/statistical_analysis.py reimplements McNemar-like statistics and binomial intervals with stdlib/scipy instead of importing p2_1/p2_3. The implementations can diverge. Recorded as a follow-up; not unified in this change.
No registered runner exercises a real provider with served-model identity. real_run class remains empty.

growth_policy.rule: No p2_8+ or new evaluation contract until a real provider run demonstrates a need. Evidence must reference the new runner entrypoint and served-model status.
